E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons

E4Plus1.uk.title: Naked Attraction

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox

E4Plus1.uk.title: Naked Attraction

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Amazing Race Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Aussie celebs and their mates, embark on a big globe-trotting race. Dashing across nations; trials, tribulations. There's really no time to waste. (S7 Ep1) #WorldPoetryDay

E4Plus1.uk.title: Made in Chelsea

E4Plus1.uk.title: Made in Chelsea
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Whispers turn into a roar. Could Jazz and Inga be something more? A bombshell at dinner derails all the fun. Is a romance over before it's begun? (S31 Ep2) #WorldPoetryDay

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: The food of love. Isn't that what they say? French cuisine is the romantic way. But The Secret Garden is far from blooming. Business is wilting. And bankruptcy's looming... #WorldPoetryDay

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The final couples say I do; will a groom's intentions ring so true? A bride on the aisle is none the wiser; will a man or a woman be there to surprise her? #WorldPoetryDay

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Honeymoons over; couples now mingle. At the dinner party; Mel still feels single. Marriages questioned. Opinions collide. Does Danny have eyes for another groom's bride?

E4Plus1.uk.title: My Spy
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2020) Dave Bautista's a spy who has a wee whine, when he must keep an eye on a fam whose girl of nine is just fine with making him look asinine. Is that a crime? #WorldPoetryDay

E4Plus1.uk.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle

E4Plus1.uk.title: Celebrity Gogglebox

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: Chefs pursue a Michelin star. Picture Slam with Alan Carr. Celebs in the jungle trying to be brave. Australian dogs that misbehave. #WorldPoetryDay [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Clay-pigeon enthusiast Emma has silver fox Jeremy in her sights but faces competition from his work phone. Meanwhile, 82-year-old 'Sauve Harv' meets lifelong singleton Dinah. (S4 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers watch Celebrity Race Across the World, All's Fair, Squid Game: The Challenge, The 1% Club, Come Dine with Me: Teens and Police Interceptors. (S26 Ep11) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers watch I'm a Celebrity..., Squid Game: The Challenge, All Her Fault, Celebrity Race Across the World, Alan Carr's Picture Slam, Knife Edge and Emmerdale. (S26 Ep12) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Cartridge Family: Marge and Lisa are horrified when Homer buys a gun. And when Bart and Milhouse find it in the fridge, Marge takes the kids to live in a motel. (S9 Ep5/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
